title: Say the unprofitable thing
body: If the honest answer is spend less, fix the product, or hire in-house instead, that's the answer you get. It costs us revenue and buys us clients who stay five years.

title: Measure before you buy
body: We won't touch a media budget until tracking is trustworthy. Roughly a third of the accounts we inherit are optimising toward a number that isn't real.

title: Senior people, small rooms
body: No pyramid. The people in the pitch are the people on the account, and there are never more than four of them.

title: Volume beats taste
body: We have opinions about creative. We have more respect for the test that proves them wrong, which is why we ship forty concepts a month instead of four.

title: Build to hand over
body: The best outcome is a client who needs us less each year. Half our engagements are designed to transfer to an in-house team inside eighteen months.

title: Own nothing of yours
body: Accounts, pixels, source files and documentation live in your workspace from day one. Leaving should be boring.
